The test image shows a soybean stem split longitudinally, revealing **brown/orange-brown discoloration of the internal pith tissue**, while the external stem remains green. This is the hallmark diagnostic feature of Brown Stem Rot.

The Brown Stem Rot reference confirms this pattern — split stems with brown pith discoloration. The key distinguishing point from SDS: the pith here is clearly brown (in SDS it stays white/cream).
